verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents H264/H265 hardware codecs. Hands-on reports describe heavy interactive daily use with visually better performance than AnyDesk, but one user found it extremely laggy even when self-hosted, and RustDesk makes no documented first-party claim about latency. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of latency or interactive-performance characteristics, independent confirmation that hardware encoding is used in practice, and consistent hands-on evidence of low latency (one user reported severe lag).

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing

citations.quote: Supports VP8 / VP9 / AV1 software codecs, and H264 / H265 hardware codecs.
A user drives RustDesk 12 hours a day on up to 9 computers and finds it visually much better than AnyDesk.
